item.title: As Nepal identifies those killed in the floods, questions grow over China's reporting
item.description: One week after the deadly floods, very little is known about China's dead or missing. China's control over media and digital censorship is in stark contrast to open reporting in Nepal.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: 5 dead after crash at Miami Airport. And, Germany's far-right wins state election
item.description: A cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport has left five people dead and several others injured. And, Germany's far-right AfD party achieves an electoral victory in a key state election.

item.title: The copper peptide trend has gone from creams to injections — ahead of the science
item.description: The peptide is supposed to deliver flawless and firm skin, promote wound healing and other anti-aging effects. So what's the evidence behind GHK-Cu?

item.title: 'Her body temperature was 106': How heat is killing Americans in their homes
item.description: Heat kills thousands of people across the U.S. every year. The risk is especially high for the millions of Americans who live in manufactured housing like mobile homes and trailers.

item.title: Investigators seek answers after Amazon cargo plane crash kills five at Miami airport
item.description: An Amazon Prime cargo plane was landing at the airport around 2 p.m. ET on Sunday when it overran the runway, crashed and rammed into vehicles on the ground, according to FAA.

item.title: Germany's far-right achieves an electoral breakthrough in key state election
item.description: Germany's populist, far-right Alternative for Germany party has declared victory in the state of Saxony-Anhalt after more than doubling its share of the vote in the first of several regional elections this fall.

item.title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Moscow Putin meeting
item.description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held meetings in Kyiv with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after lengthy conversations with Russian President Putin in Moscow.
